## Historical Materialist Hook

[RESEARCH REQUIRED: Utilize Evald Ilyenkov's Dialectical Logic and A.N. Kolmogorov's work to supply the Soviet materialist critique of static classical truth, demonstrating how intuitionism was pragmatically reframed as a labor-centric logic of problems.]

## Core Technical Synthesis

[RESEARCH REQUIRED: Introduce the Formalization Portfolio. Students must translate historically significant philosophical or mathematical arguments into first-order syntax and execute a flawless, computer-verified proof inside the Carnap framework to demonstrate objective validity.]

:::{.guided-example}
<div class="guided-example-title">
Guided Example: The Formalization Portfolio
</div>
<div class="guided-example-content">
**The Goal:** Select a classic argument (e.g., Anselm's Ontological Argument, or a fragment of Euclid's Elements).
**Step 1:** Translate the natural language premises into strict First-Order Logic.
**Step 2:** Construct a full Fitch-style derivation in Carnap to prove the conclusion follows from the premises.
**Step 3:** Document any semantic ambiguities you encountered during translation.
</div>
:::
